The '''V-23 Poison Disperser''' was a weapon developed by [[House of Organa/Legends|House Organa]]. It was designed to combat [[Killik/Legends|Killiks]] by quickly and effectively dispensing custom-made [[Poison/Legends|poison]] over large areas.<ref>{{TORcite|type=general|The Killik Problem|Alderaan}}</ref>
